Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.cosmetics

Class CosmeticEquipEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.cosmetics.CosmeticEquipEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public final class CosmeticEquipEvent extends ZentrixEvent implements org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
Called before a player's own choice of cosmetic is saved, in any type, built-in or an addon's: equipping one, or unequipping to go back to the type's default. Made in the cosmetics menu or by an addon through CosmeticsService#equip and #unequip.

For built-in categories CosmeticSelectEvent is called first; cancelling either keeps the current choice. Choices made through CosmeticsService#select do not fire this event. Cancelling from the menu plays its error sound; telling the player why is up to the listener.

Main thread; only fired while a listener is registered.

Since:
1.11.0
